Name: Set up Stripe subscription tiers
Description: Owner: Taylor and Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks from the meeting date. Task: Configure the three subscription tiers (Basic $29, Pro $49, Enterprise $99) in Stripe and ensure correct reflection in the app in terms of functionality and user experience. Acceptance criteria: All subscription tiers functional and integrated in the app accordingly.

Name: Develop frontend Stripe Elements checkout flow
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks from the meeting date. Task: Implement the Stripe Elements checkout form styled to match app design, including error handling for invalid card details and insufficient funds. Make checkout button prominent and include tooltip/help icon explaining plan changes. Acceptance criteria: Functional, secure, and user-friendly checkout matching app design with proper error handling.

Name: Update pricing page with new subscription tiers
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks from the meeting date. Task: Update the app's pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers and their features clearly and cleanly. Acceptance criteria: Pricing page updated and visually clear to users.

Name: Develop user dashboard subscription management features
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within two weeks from meeting date. Task: Implement dashboard showing current plan and billing info, options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscription, access to invoices and payment history, ability to update payment methods. Ensure real-time reflection of subscription status and user notifications for changes and failures. Acceptance criteria: Dashboard functional, intuitive, and real-time updated with notifications.

Name: Integrate Stripe API for subscription management
Description: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within two weeks from meeting date. Task: Backend integration to handle creating and managing subscriptions, processing payments (successful and failed), and managing webhook events (invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.deleted). Acceptance criteria: Backend processes subscriptions and payments correctly, handles webhooks updating system accurately.

Name: Set up and test webhook event handlers
Description: Owner: Taylor. Deadline: within three weeks (one week after initial integration). Task: Create webhook handlers for invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted events. Develop and execute detailed manual and automated test plans simulating various scenarios including payment failures and cancellations. Acceptance criteria: Webhook handlers functioning correctly, tested and verified.

Name: Integrate frontend with backend API for subscription updates
Description: Owner: Jordan. Deadline: within three weeks (after backend setup). Task: Connect frontend user dashboard and checkout to backend API ensuring real-time subscription status updates and error notifications for users. Acceptance criteria: Frontend reflects backend changes promptly with clear user messages.

Name: Prepare user documentation and support materials
Description: Owner: Alex, Jordan, and Taylor. Deadline: after feature completion and testing. Task: Develop clear user instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, changing plans, and handling common issues. Create help section or FAQ covering subscription-related questions. Taylor to document API endpoints and webhook handlers for future maintenance. Acceptance criteria: Comprehensive documentation and support materials ready and accessible to users and developers.

Name: Schedule follow-up meeting to review progress
Description: Owner: Alex. Deadline: within one week from the meeting date. Task: Organize next team meeting to review integration progress, discuss any blockers, and plan further steps. Acceptance criteria: Meeting scheduled and conducted with updates shared.
